stem: In what way do Brody’s conversations with his friends help develop the story’s plot?

options.label: A
options.text: The conversations help Brody appreciate his experiences in the country.

options.label: B
options.text: The conversations make Brody understand how much he is needed by others.

options.label: C
options.text: The conversations urge Brody to find a way to make his visit useful to his school work.

options.label: D
options.text: The conversations cause Brody to feel worse by hearing about the fun he is missing.
